subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should ordinary agent writes expose append as `append?: boolean` on `write`, or should maintainers require a `mode` field or separate append tool before landing?
rationale: Source and issue evidence support a first-class append primitive, but the permanent model-facing tool contract is a maintainer-owned API/product choice.

options.title: Accept `append?: boolean`
options.body: Land this PR or a small equivalent if maintainers want the smallest backwards-compatible extension to the existing write tool.

options.title: Switch to `mode`
options.body: Ask the branch to replace the boolean with an explicit write mode if maintainers want a more extensible contract now.

options.title: Use a separate append tool
options.body: Keep `write` overwrite-only and request a separate append tool if maintainers want destructive and append operations isolated.

recommendation.title: Accept `append?: boolean`
recommendation.body: Land this PR or a small equivalent if maintainers want the smallest backwards-compatible extension to the existing write tool.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the agent runtime/tool API boundary shaped by their agent-runtime ownership history.
